authority: Closed retained source and explicit human authoring requirements only; no new external sources.

limitations.historicalClaim: Transparent anterior sclera, dyed iris, a lens-like layer, semi-liquid vitreous, and retina described as optic-nerve branches ending in rods and cones.
limitations.clarification: Keep the original numbered correspondences while distinguishing cornea from sclera, tissue pigmentation, crystalline lens, gel-like vitreous, retinal photoreceptors and other cells, and outgoing optic-nerve signaling.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess anatomical accuracy and age-appropriate wording; FIG must independently assess the future modern anatomical drawing without relying on this author as visual evidence.

limitations.historicalClaim: Reflex pupil diameter range and camera aperture analogy.
limitations.clarification: Preserve both original endpoints and the light-control analogy, while explicitly calling the range approximate and condition- and person-dependent.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess the qualification; no pupil measurement, medical threshold or new numerical recommendation is supplied.

limitations.historicalClaim: Whole-eye converging lens with variable focal length, fixed image distance and retinal screen.
limitations.clarification: Scope the equivalent thin lens to near-axis/paraxial analysis, approximate the fixed image distance, retain the inverted real image, and distinguish the multisurface living eye and retina from lens and flat-screen objects.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess model boundaries; no new lens equation or quantitative model is introduced.

limitations.historicalClaim: Muscle tension compresses the lens, reduces focal length, and defines near and far limits.
limitations.clarification: Explicitly replace literal body compression with ciliary-muscle/suspensory-fiber-mediated curvature change, retain refocusing and finite near point, and bind the ideal infinite far point to relaxed accommodation without refractive error.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess mechanism and relaxed-state assumptions; no measured near point is inferred.

limitations.historicalClaim: Larger visual angle separates point images and the source angular threshold maps them to different nerve endings.
limitations.clarification: Retain visual angle, approaching-object reasoning and the original angular reference, but identify it as approximate and include contrast, illumination and retinal/neural processing rather than a guaranteed one-cell rule.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess resolution wording; this is not a vision-test threshold or diagnostic instruction.

limitations.historicalClaim: A fixed comfortable distance for normal eyes, shorter for myopia, longer for hyperopia, and restored by spectacles.
limitations.clarification: Retain the original comfortable-reference value and near-viewing inequality, but separate the elementary-optics convention, actual near point, available accommodation and individual comfort.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must check that source conclusions remain conditional and ZHEN must check equal strength of qualification; no universal comfortable distance is asserted.

limitations.historicalClaim: Differences in muscular tension and left/right retinal images provide distance and stereoscopic impressions.
limitations.clarification: Preserve both muscle-related and binocular-image cues while using coordinated convergence and disparity rather than a universal left-right tension difference or direct muscle-tension ruler.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess binocular cue wording; original difficult material is retained, not omitted.

limitations.historicalClaim: Relaxed myopic focus lies before the retina; diverging spectacles make parallel rays appear to originate at the finite far point.
limitations.clarification: Retain focus position, finite far point, lens type and labeled ray construction, but make relaxed distant viewing depend on an optically matched lens and avoid universal normal-vision promises.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess ray construction; FIG must review future panel labels and the far-point label independently.

limitations.historicalClaim: Behind-retina distant focus, accommodation at distance, harder near viewing, and converging-lens corrections.
limitations.clarification: Bind behind-retina convergence to the relaxed model, explain actual retinal interception, make compensation conditional on available accommodation, and preserve distant and near converging-lens constructions and reduced divergence.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess accommodation-state and virtual-image-distance interpretation; FIG must independently review all future panels.

limitations.historicalClaim: Spectacle corrections restore relaxed or comfortable viewing.
limitations.clarification: Present only the source's qualitative optical constructions, with no diagnosis, prescription, medical recommendation, additional numerical value or new formula.
limitations.pendingReview: SCI and ZHEN must assess that neither language reads as a clinical recommendation.
